title: Camps family form for a camp that is for both schools: no school named at all (proposal for v0.756)
subtitle: Jeffrey, 2026-11-11: "Dont have it say both schools at all. Show me a mockup of what the form will look like for the parents registering." Real preview screens of the built page (April Vacation Camp, a camp for both schools), with the school line taken out of the page to show the result. Amber = what differs. The page's header already says "Jae H. Jeong's U.S. Taekwondo Center", so the parent still knows whose camp it is; the school line and the "Where" row are what go. One-school camps keep their school line.

sections.heading: 1 · The form: top of the page (Step 1)

columns.label: After (proposed)

row.caption: PC: the line is gone; the hours follow the dates. Nothing replaces it.
Phone (390 and 320): the same; the card is one line shorter.

columns.note: No "Both schools", no "Worcester & Shrewsbury", no "held at", no street address. The rest of the card (dates, hours, ages, pizza party, early price, the camp's own description) is unchanged.

columns.label: After (proposed)

row.caption: PC: the "Where" row is gone; "About the camp" follows "Camp".

columns.note: The "Pay at the school before camp" words are the same for every camp and name no school, so they stay.

footer: Also changes with it (words only, not drawn): the registration link's QR card (the dashboard's Registration link box, the picture staff print or save) has no school heading under the camp's name, and the printed receipt has no "School" row, for a camp for both schools. A one-school camp's QR card and receipt still say "Worcester" or "Shrewsbury". Staff screens: the camp list's "Both schools" under the camp's name, its School column on the Both switcher, and Edit camp's School choice (Worcester | Shrewsbury | Both schools) are how staff say which schools a camp is for; they stay unless you want them gone too (question 1). No database change.
